Adfox

A platform for managing online ads on sites, video resources, mobile apps, and Telegram channels.

Features

Serve ads from multiple sources

Manage direct ad sales, run your own promo campaigns, and set up monetization with the Yandex Advertising Network and ad exchanges.
Learn more

Manage your ad inventory

Connect your sites, video resources, mobile apps, and Telegram channels. Customize your campaigns and banners.
Learn more

Explore multiple ad formats

Static ads, animated ads, video ads, and other formats for any type of placement.
Learn more

Precise targeting

Target your ads by frequency, demographics, location, Yandex Audience segments, and more.
Learn more

Granular analytics

Track performance across your entire inventory and campaigns with real-time statistics.
Learn more

Viewability and fraud protection

That comply with international IMS advertising standards.
Learn more

Ad labeling tools

Submit data to ERIR through the Yandex advertising data operator (ADO) and add the Ad label.
Learn more

Manage user roles for your team

Set separate access levels for publishers, assistants, and advertisers.
Learn more

API

Automate your campaign management and analytics.
Learn more
